title: Rook First, Queen After
setup: Your rook on d6 and queen on d4 both look down the d-file at a back rank guarded only by the rook on c8.
hint: The order matters. Decide which piece can afford to be captured and which one has to deliver.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rd8+}} is the cheap one: {{Rxd8}} is forced and the c8 rook leaves the rank it was guarding. {{Qxd8#}} finishes. Lead with the piece you can spare, and keep the one that mates.
